company.name: Visionaries Club
company.tagline: Visionaries is a leading European early-stage VC backed by Europe's most successful digital and industrial entrepreneurs
company.description:
Visionaries Club is a leading European early-stage venture capital fund with offices in London and Berlin, investing across Europe through its Seed, Early Growth and Visionaries Tomorrow funds. 

Visionaries’ community of LPs unites Europe’s leading unicorn founders with a huge network of family business entrepreneurs, who are looking to digitise traditional industries. This includes founders of successful technology companies UiPath, Miro, Wolt, Flixbus, Supercell, Zalando, Mollie, Spotify, Personio, Adyen, HelloFresh and Skype alongside industrial giants such as Swarovski, Miele, Mittal, Haniel, Stihl, Siemens as well as sporting entrepreneurs like Mario Goetze and Nico Rosberg. With its unique network and B2B investment focus, Visionaries is bridging the information asymmetry of “what's possible” in the technology startup space and “what is actually needed” in the industrial space by partnering with the next generation of software superstars. 

Visionaries Club has ~€600m AuM and counts Lovable, Personio, Miro, Pigment, Tacto, Tandem Health, Choco and Xentral among its portfolio companies.
